name: io.github.kutluege/posta-mcp
title: posta-mcp
description: Local IMAP/SMTP email MCP server with a Bogazici University preset; sending is opt-in.

environmentVariables.name: POSTA_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Mailbox or app password (or store it in the OS keychain with `posta-mcp setup`)

environmentVariables.name: POSTA_ALLOW_SEND
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to allow sending; each send still needs your confirmation
